result.instructions: Tools for NeetoInvoice, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which unbilled time entries does the Acme project have this month?"; "List the invoices that are overdue and show who they are for."; "Generate an invoice for Acme from the unbilled time entries and number it INV-2026-043.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NeetoInvoice data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run neetoinvoice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run neetoinvoice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run neetoinvoice_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. neetoinvoice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the workspace's clients ordered by name, with status and currency. Start here to find a client_id. NeetoInvoice API: GET /clients.

name.description: Only clients whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: neetoinvoice_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by client_id. NeetoInvoice API: GET /clients/{client_id}.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client in the workspace. Writes data. NeetoInvoice API: POST /clients.

secondary_name.description: Optional secondary name, such as a subsidiary.

default_invoice_due_in_days.description: Days until an invoice is due by default.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Change a client's details or status (status active or archived). Writes data. NeetoInvoice API: PATCH /clients/{client_id}.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

default_invoice_due_in_days.description: New default due period in days.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the workspace's projects ordered by name: billing method, rate, client and status. NeetoInvoice API: GET /projects.

client_id.description: Only projects of this client (client ID or identifier).

email.description: Only projects this user is assigned to.

name.description: Only projects whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: neetoinvoice_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by project_id. NeetoInvoice API: GET /projects/{project_id}.

project_id.description: The project ID from the matching list or create tool.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a project for a client, with its tasks (at least one). Writes data. NeetoInvoice API: POST /projects.

email.description: Email of the acting team member. NeetoInvoice records the change under this user.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

billing_method.description: Billing strategy, for example hourly_person_rate, hourly_project_rate or fixed_price_project.

tasks.description: Tasks to create in the project. NeetoInvoice requires at least one.

hourly_rate.description: Hourly rate. Needed for hourly billing methods.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_project_users
tools.title: List project users
tools.description: List the users assigned to one project, with their roles and hourly rates. NeetoInvoice API: GET /projects/{project_id}/project-users.

project_id.description: The project ID from the matching list or create tool.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the workspace's team members with their roles and status. NeetoInvoice API: GET /team-members.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_time_entries
tools.title: List unbilled time entries
tools.description: List unbilled time entries for one project. Billed entries are left out. NeetoInvoice API: GET /time-entries.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

project_id.description: The project ID from the matching list or create tool.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_create_time_entry
tools.title: Create a time entry
tools.description: Log hours on a project task for a team member on one date. Writes data. NeetoInvoice API: POST /time-entries.

email.description: Email of the acting team member. NeetoInvoice records the change under this user.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

project_id.description: The project ID from the matching list or create tool.

task_id.description: The task ID from the matching list or create tool.

recorded_on.description: Date the work was done, in yyyy-mm-dd.

hours.description: Hours worked, as text, for example "1.5".

is_override.description: Override the project's autolock for this entry.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the workspace's invoices, newest issue date first. Deleted invoices are left out. NeetoInvoice API: GET /invoices.

client_id.description: Only this client's invoices (client ID or identifier).

overdue.description: True lists only unpaid invoices past their due date.

start_date.description: Only invoices issued on or after this date.

end_date.description: Only invoices issued on or before this date.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_generate_invoice
tools.title: Generate an invoice
tools.description: Generate an invoice for a client from unbilled time entries and fixed price projects. It runs in the background, so it returns status generating. Writes data. NeetoInvoice API: POST /clients/{client_id}/invoices.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

email.description: Email of the acting team member. NeetoInvoice records the change under this user.

due_date_period.description: Days until the invoice is due.

time_entry_ids.description: Unbilled time entries to bill (time entry IDs).

project_id.description: Fixed price projects to bill (project IDs). Each is billed for its remaining amount.

include_time_entries.description: Show detailed time entries on the invoice.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_send_invoice
tools.title: Send an invoice
tools.description: Email a generated invoice to the client's recipients and mark it sent. This emails a customer. NeetoInvoice API: POST /clients/{client_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/send.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

invoice_id.description: The invoice ID from the matching list or create tool.

email.description: Email of the acting team member. NeetoInvoice records the change under this user.

recipient_ids.description: Recipient IDs. Omit to send to every current recipient.

subject.description: Email subject. Omit for the workspace default.

message.description: Email body. Omit for the workspace default.

send_me_a_copy.description: Also send a copy to the acting user.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_mark_invoice_paid
tools.title: Mark an invoice as paid
tools.description: Record a payment received outside NeetoInvoice, such as a bank transfer. Without amount, the full balance is recorded. Writes data. NeetoInvoice API: POST /clients/{client_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/mark-paid.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

invoice_id.description: The invoice ID from the matching list or create tool.

email.description: Email of the acting team member. NeetoInvoice records the change under this user.

amount.description: Amount received, up to 2 decimal places. Defaults to the full balance.

payment_date.description: Date the payment was received. Defaults to today.

notes.description: Notes saved with the payment, such as a bank reference.

notify_client.description: Email the recipients a payment confirmation.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_void_invoice
tools.title: Void an invoice
tools.description: Write off a generated invoice: it is no longer owed, and its status becomes written_off. The invoice is kept. Writes data. NeetoInvoice API: POST /clients/{client_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/void.

client_id.description: The client ID from the matching list or create tool.

invoice_id.description: The invoice ID from the matching list or create tool.

email.description: Email of the acting team member. NeetoInvoice records the change under this user.

notes.description: Why the invoice was voided. Existing notes are kept when omitted.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_monthly_ptos
tools.title: List monthly PTO
tools.description: List what each user earned and used in one month. Every PTO value is in hours. NeetoInvoice API: GET /monthly-ptos.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_get_payroll_summary
tools.title: Get the payroll summary
tools.description: Per user, the weekdays in a month, the days with time logged and the loss-of-pay days. NeetoInvoice API: GET /reports/payroll-summary.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_list_missing_timesheet_entries
tools.title: List missing timesheet days
tools.description: List the weekdays in a date range with nothing logged, for one user or the whole team. NeetoInvoice API: GET /reports/missing-entries.

start_date.description: First day of the range, in yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Last day of the range, in yyyy-mm-dd.

email.description: Only this user's missing days. Omit for the whole team.

tools.name: neetoinvoice_get_timesheet_summary
tools.title: Get the timesheet summary
tools.description: Hours logged in a date range, per user and per day with each entry. NeetoInvoice API: GET /reports/timesheet-summary.

start_date.description: First day of the range, in yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Last day of the range, in yyyy-mm-dd.

email.description: Only this user's hours. Omit to cover every user with entries.

prompts.name: review_missing_timesheet_days

prompts.name: record_a_payment_or_email_an_invoice
prompts.title: Record a payment or email an invoice
prompts.description: Record a payment received outside NeetoInvoice. Or send a generated invoice, which emails the client's recipients.
